CustomVariableValue.description:
A value type for custom paywall variables that can be passed to paywalls at runtime.

Custom variables allow developers to personalize paywall text with dynamic values. Variables are defined in the MonetKit dashboard and can be overridden at runtime.   Factory methods for creating CustomVariableValue instances.

we'll utilize the `tab_id` field instead but need this for backwards compatibility
